reuse.why: Changes the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount and routes getScheduledAmount and the two remaining inline midpoint copies (updateActions, schedule-template) through it.

duplication.why: Removes all midpoint copies; call sites still keep their own small null/number/isbetween dispatch around the helper, which is pre-existing.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module both server and desktop-client already use for schedule amounts.

scope.why: Focused on the rule; the comment-only edits in Balance.tsx and other call sites are related upkeep.

maintainability.why: After the change there is one definition of the expected ranged amount, with getScheduledAmount delegating to it.

one_place.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; getScheduledAmount, schedule-template, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, forecast and preview all use it
